title: ADD please
body: Love this App, but guys Please, PLEASE!! Add more pages, 24 streaks, it’s not enough. Please ❤️❤️
author: Onnyyssoosshh

title: Fantasticke
body: To jsem hledal dlouho pro sledovani sve rutiny. Navic za jednorazovou platbu a s minimalnim zasahem do soukromi v telefonu. Navic funguje i na Apple Watch. Bravo!
author: Lekolado

title: Best tracking app I ever tried
body: I have been searching for good habit tracker for ages, before I gave a shot to Streaks. I wanted minimalistic app without any ads and distractions, ideally without subscription, that is easy to set up. Streaks it exactly that. Since you can set up how many times a week/month/whatever you want to do you task, it has a vacation mode, it can set up negative streaks, eg. For breaking addictions, I have yet to find something it cannot do. Perfect!
author: EnnTheRell

title: Duolingo pro disciplínu
body: Naprosto skvělá aplikace která umožňuje trackovat klíčové rituály které člověk chce zavést do života. Dodává mi odměnu s dokopne me k tomu že plnim co jsem si předsevzal
author: Vormacher

title: Love it!
body: Such a simple, yet powerful tool. I especially appreciate the attention to detail.
author: Saudruch

title: Doesn’t worth the money
body:
Unfortunately I just bought this app and I don’t like it :( Yes it will track your habits, but I wished for a very simple and easy to use app - and I didn’t get it. The visual part is not very  nice (even though I changed the colours) and the app is not very intuitive. After an hour I was soo stressed by using this app that I just deleted it. 

Wish there was a free trial (for which I was looking but haven’t found) so I relied on good reviews. :(

author: Bagr98

title: Nice app but sync not working
body:
I am really disappointed with this app. It is overall great but the sync is not working at all. I complete all the tasks through my apple watch and still the next day it shows half of the tasks as skipped when I check app in the phone.
Also the reminders are not working. I set up 6 reminders per day for one task and I receive sometimes 1, sometimes 3 reminders. This makes the app useless. Please do some update and fix these issues
author: Iveta12456

title: Nice app
body: The only thing that bothers me is the apple watch integration. Everything requires too many steps/taps. Workout integration does not launch streaks-workout app. I do handle ALL those thing on my apple watch. Take pill? Bam - tap - done. Workout? Run the excercise by one tap - finished? Done. No more tapping here and there, swiping, confirming and so on. Simplify notifications on siri watchface. Two icons and one paragraph of text is just too much. If I have to choose between a reminder and a streak for taking my medication… sure streaks would be more suitable… but reminders is just one tap.

body: I really enjoy using this app. It’s worth every penny. The completion animation is really satisfying. 👍🏻 One feature I would love to see in one of the upcoming updates would be a possibility to write down notes to a specific dates, so I will know in the feature why I didnt complete a task on a specific date.
